messages:
maria: Heads-up — I have three migration-guide PRs (mg-101, mg-102, mg-103) and a new SDK snippet PR that need reviewers before Friday's merge window. CI/docs preview is flaky on mg-102. Can folks pick these up? Thanks.

kevin: I can take mg-102 and the SDK snippet. Which one is flaking?

maria: mg-102 — preview times out on linkcheck and one code block is rendering as inline. CI log shows `ERROR: Linkcheck timeout` and `RenderError: fenced code block missing lang`.

ci-bot: preview build failed for PR #452 (mg-102) — linkcheck timeout after 300s; job id: build-7821.

kevin: I'm running `make preview` locally now, will try with `LINKCHECK_TIMEOUT=600`.

kevin: ```
Linkcheck: checking https://example.com/old-docs -> timeout after 60s
Render: docs/migration/steps.md:45: fenced code block missing language
```

anita: I can pick up mg-101 and do a link sweep. If mg-102 needs a language tag fix I can handle a quick patch.

jack: I can take mg-103 but I'm OOO tomorrow morning — will do it later today (before 3pm).

maria: Awesome. Assigning: @kevin -> mg-102 + SDK snippet, @anita -> mg-101, @jack -> mg-103. Kevin, ping here once preview passes.

kevin: noted. Quick checklist: 1) add language to fenced block (```bash), 2) rerun linkcheck with extended timeout, 3) confirm embedded images render. Will update in ~20m.

anita: :thumbsup: I'll also run `./scripts/linkfix.sh` to auto-detect 301s and replace canonical URLs where possible.

jack: FYI if anyone needs to swap last minute, contact #docs-rotation — I'm flexible after 3pm.

maria: Thanks all — marking this thread for merge-window prep. If CI keeps flaking we can land the small SDK snippet behind a feature flag and follow up with the migration docs in a hotfix roll.

kevin: mg-102 preview passed locally after adding the language tag and bumping timeout. Pushed fix to PR and requested review.

anita: I reviewed mg-101 and did a quick link pass. Left two tiny wording nits, approving after those edits.

jack: mg-103 looks good to me; fixed a dead example link. Ready for merge.

maria: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll queue these for the Friday merge window and update the release note checklist. :sparkles:
